Samira Khan: Quick Week 1 async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

What I did:
- Completed IDP SSO and accepted the org invite.
- Generated SSH keys and pushed to GitHub. `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` ran ok.
- Walked through infra quickstart until the registry pull step.

Blockers:
- MFA enrollment keeps failing with 'device not found' when I try to register my phone in Okta.
- Can't pull base images: `docker pull docker.redwood.internal/base:py38` => 403. Suspect DNS/firewall on corporate wifi.
- CI jobs error when pushing images: `unauthorized: authentication required` (maybe creds not added to docker config).
- kubectl can't find the dev cluster context after `gcloud container clusters get-credentials`: no `dev` context in `kubectl config get-contexts`.

Today:
- Try enrolling MFA via phone hotspot instead of corp wifi.
- Attach the `curl -v` output for the registry and kubeconfig dump here if helpful.
- Would also appreciate a quick eyes-on PR ping for #112 (tiny README update) if someone has a sec.

Alex Chen: Hey Samira — welcome! :wave: Sounds like a few separate issues, quick suggestions:
- MFA: try registering while on your phone hotspot. Okta sometimes blocks from corp networks. Command we use for debugging: `okta-verify enroll --debug` (ask IT before sharing logs).
- DNS: try `dig docker.redwood.internal @8.8.8.8` and `curl -v https://docker.redwood.internal/v2/` and paste the output here. If you get an IP back but TLS fails it's probably internal cert block.
- Registry auth: check `~/.docker/config.json` for an auth entry. You can try `docker logout registry.redwood.internal && docker login registry.redwood.internal` and use the temporary token Marta can provide.
- Kube: run `kubectl config view --minify` and `gcloud container clusters get-credentials dev --zone us-west1-b --project redwood-dev` then `kubectl config get-contexts`. If `dev` doesn't appear, the get-credentials step is failing — paste stderr.

If you want, I can jump on a quick 15-min call to walk through these after you paste outputs.

Marta R.: @Samira Khan I opened IT ticket IT-4892 and linked your outputs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-4892 — marking as high priority since Docker registry 403 + MFA failure looks like an access wave hitting onboarding.
- For now I created a 24h scoped registry token for you (I'll DM it).
- Can you paste the `curl -v` output and the `dig` result here? Also, ping me the public IP shown at https://ifconfig.me so I can check firewall logs.
- MFA: we sometimes see Okta block requests from corp VPN or proxies. Hotspot usually works; if not, I'll escalate to infra to whitelist the device family.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist reminder — docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/new-hires
- Step 6: "Register MFA" — troubleshooting tips are at the bottom of that page.
- If you haven't yet, run `gcloud auth application-default login` and follow the quickstart for `dev` cluster under the "Infra access" section.

Samira Khan: Thanks all — will try hotspot and paste the `dig` + `curl` outputs here in ~20m. Also pushed PR #112 link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/112 — tag @alex for review when you have a moment. :pray:
